items.contentSnippet:
This is a side project I've been working on on-and-off (mostly off) since the 1990s. I guess you would call it an experimental "dating site" though it's designed to be fun/interesting to people who aren't single (like me).
You don't need to sign in to see how it works, so try it out. There is no swiping.

items.title: Show HN: Woodshed, an on-device practice and songwriting journal for musicians
items.contentSnippet:
I recently built Woodshed, a (free) iOS songwriting + practice journal I’ve wanted forever.
It's designed to get out of your way while you play, but make it easy to catalog, rate, annotate and listen later.
Over time, it learns what you play to match pieces, search by playing, and generally avoid the drudgery that comes with managing a library.
I hope other musicians find it as useful as I have, and I'd welcome any feedback.
https://getwoodshed.com
